title: The Bank That Never Opens Its Doors
hook: Deep inside a Swiss mountain, a bank exists with no branches, no website, and no clients—just a single vault that holds the debts of fallen empires.
why_this_can_go_viral: The mystery of an invisible institution triggers immediate curiosity and paranoia about hidden financial networks.

title: The Dividend That Only Ghosts Collect
